name: Southern Palms Beach Resort
description: Southern Palms Beach Resort, nestled on the pristine sands of Diani Beach, is a tropical paradise that combines African-inspired elegance with modern luxury. The resort is ideal for families, senior travelers, couples, and solo adventurers, offering spacious lagoon-style pools, swaying palm gardens, and direct access to soft white sands lapped by the turquoise Indian Ocean. Guests can enjoy water sports, sunset walks on the beach, or spa treatments in a serene environment. It's the perfect base for combining a Kenya safari extension with a peaceful coastal retreat.

name: Swahili Beach Resort
description: Swahili Beach Resort in Diani Beach blends Afro-Arab architecture, cascading pools, and barefoot luxury to create one of Kenya's most iconic coastal escapes. Ideal for families, senior travelers, couples, and solo beach lovers, the resort offers a serene environment with gently sloping walkways, shaded lounging spaces, and a warm tropical breeze drifting in from the private beach. Guests come for its lagoon-style pools, famous Coco Beach bar, soothing Swahili Spa, and vibrant cultural touches that make every stay feel deeply immersive.

name: Turtle Bay Beach Club
description: Turtle Bay Beach Club, nestled on a shimmering 200-metre stretch of pristine sand in Watamu, is a tropical paradise surrounded by lush gardens and framed by the Watamu Marine National Park. Perfect for families, couples, and senior travelers alike, Turtle Bay blends eco-sensitive design with vibrant water-based fun: from snorkeling over coral reefs to evening entertainment under the stars. With 145 rooms, three restaurants, three bars, watersports, a kids' club, and eco-tourism credentials, it offers a rich coastal escape that resonates with joy, rest, and discovery.

name: Hemingways Watamu
description: Hemingways Watamu is a legendary luxury beachfront resort set along the powder-soft sands of Watamu Marine National Park, one of Kenya's most pristine and scenic coastlines. This elegant property blends timeless style with modern comfort, offering spacious ocean-view rooms and suites ideal for couples, seniors, families, and solo travellers seeking a peaceful, high-end beach escape. Hemingways Watamu is known for its personalised service, serene ambience, world-class deep-sea fishing, and access to coral gardens perfect for snorkelling.
